svg.title: Forge IDE Mail wireframe
svg.desc: Proposed Mail inbox, new message, active thread, and read-only archive on a phone, with a desktop split view and rules for background delivery and archiving.
svg.text: Proposed wireframe with example threads and messages

text.tspan: Write a maintenance note with a schedule,
verification steps, and a rollback plan.
Replies appear in Mail. You can close this
tab while the model works.
Write a maintenance note with a schedule,
verification steps, and a rollback plan.
Start Saturday at 9:00 AM. Post a status
update before maintenance begins.
Check the home page and a test sign-in.
Record the results in the maintenance log.

g.text: If either check fails, restore the prior version.

text.tspan: The saved thread has too little room
for a useful follow-up.
Turn the verification section into a short
checklist for the on-call team.
• Open the home page.
• Confirm a test sign-in.
• Record both results in the log.

g.text: Write a maintenance note with a schedule, verification steps, and a rollback plan.
Start Saturday at 9:00 AM. Post a status update before maintenance begins.
Check the home page and a test sign-in. Record the results in the maintenance log.
If either check fails, restore the prior version and update the team.

text.tspan: Send returns to the saved thread as soon as it's queued.
Open Mail from any signed-in tab to see the reply.

g.text: If a draft is too long

text.tspan: Keep the text in the composer so the user can shorten
it or use it in a new message. The thread stays active
if it has room for a shorter follow-up.
After a reply is saved, archive the thread when it has
too little context room for another useful exchange.
The full transcript stays available under Archive.
